{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute the number of valid age entries (non -1)
valid_age_count = (df['customer_age'] != -1).sum()

# Compute mean age on valid entries
mean_age = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f"Number of valid age entries: {valid_age_count}")
print(f"Mean age (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}")"}
